tips: You can set the room size up to 12 players.
Room round time can be set from 5 to 150 seconds.
[Scramble] is a game mode where you look at randomized letters and guess the original word.
[Anything] is a game mode where you can submit any word in the language to pass the turn.
[Calc Relay] is a game mode where players take turns solving math problems shown on screen.
[Calc Battle] is a game mode where you compete to solve math problems as fast as possible.
If a problem is too hard in [Calc Battle], type 'gg' to skip it.
If you can't solve it in [Initial Quiz] or [Scramble], type 'gg' to give up.
[Chain Battle] is a game mode where you play word relay alone with a given starting letter and compete on the number of words.
[Panel Flip] is a game mode where you type the words on the board to make them yours. You get score based on the number of boards.
[Speed Quiz] is a game mode where you type the answer to the quiz on the screen.
If everyone readies but the host doesn't start, the host is automatically spectated after 1 minute and the game starts.
If the host is spectating, the game automatically starts 1 minute after everyone readies.
If a room without a password is not played (including practice) for 10 minutes, it disappears.
[Manner] rule blocks both unchainable words and single-hit words, but [Shi.] rule only blocks single-hit words, so you can still use unchainable words.
If you turn on [Easy Mis.], you can clear missions by matching the consonant and vowel regardless of the final consonant.
If you turn on [More Mis.], vowels like ㅓ, ㅗ, ㅜ, ㅔ, ㅣ will appear as missions in addition to ㅏ.
If you turn on [Special], verbs and adjectives can be used, and with [Flexible], even weirder words can be used!
There are 5 types of items in [Item Mode]: Skip, Reverse, Pass, Random, Middle/End Relay. Middle/End Relay only appears in KKuTu types.
[Skip] item skips the next person after your turn.
[Reverse] item reverses the turn direction before your turn.
[Pass] item passes the turn directly to the next person before your turn.
[Random] item passes the turn to a random person after your turn.
[Middle] and [Wordchain] items apply Middle Relay or En Relay only to yourself.
If you turn on [Goodword], you cannot use words containing swearing.
In [K. KungKungTta], you basically use 3-letter words, but you can change it to [3-2], [2-2], [4-4], [4-3].
In [E. KungKungTta], you basically use 5-letter words, but you can choose 3~7 letters in special rules.
If you turn on [Unknown], you can only use words not in the dictionary.
If you turn on [Unknown], you can get up to 100 EXP and 10 PINGS.
If you turn on [Triple] in Word Match, 3 topics appear per round, and you can submit a word from any of the 3.
If you turn on [Big Board] in SokSok mode, the on-screen letters are approximately doubled.
If you turn on [1 Chance], you are immediately game over if you fail to type.
If you turn on [Survival], you start with HP instead of score, and reduce neighbor's HP by the score gained. The last one standing wins.
If a turn is changed using an item in Survival mode, the damage goes to the changed person.
If you turn on [Return], you can use words unused in the last 5 turns. But no score.
If you turn on [Middle], you relay with the middle letter. If the word length is even, it uses the second half's character.
If you turn on [Second], you relay with the second to last character.
If you turn on [Head], you relay with the very first given character.
If you turn on [Random], a random letter from the word is chosen to relay. Unchainable letters don't appear in Manner mode.
In KKuTu type modes, the letter to be chained is highlighted in light blue.
If you turn on [Long] in Typing Battle, 9~13 letter words appear instead of 2~5.
If you turn on [Vowel] in Initial Quiz, you can enjoy it with vowels.
If you turn on [Unlimited] in quiz modes, answers can be of any length.
Basically Initial Quiz & Picture Quiz have 2~7 letters answers, and Scramble has 4~7.
If you turn on [Free Ini] in Word Relay, you can freely change ㄹ to ㄴ or ㅇ regardless of vowels.
If you apply [Vowel Inv] in Word Relay, you can chain by reversing the Yin/Yang vowels.
If you turn on [Speed], turn time is halved but round time remains.
In Hunminjeongeum, you can set it to give 3 initial consonants instead of 2.
You can get Toss Bonus by submitting a word ending with the first character of the previous word.
You can get Straight Bonus by increasing your word length item by item over 2 times.
You can get Full House Bonus by typing a word that includes all characters you submitted before.
You can get Jackpot Bonus by submitting same length words over 3 times. Length must be 7+.
You can get Flush Bonus by passing the same character over 3 times.
You can get Defense Bonus by defusing an attack word or flush word.
It is recommended not to turn on [Drug]... Anyway...
If you turn on [Apple] in Korean SokSok, you can watch Bad Apple.
If you turn on [Stonks], all bonus scores including mission, toss, straight are doubled.
With [Falloff], you get 0 points if you fail the turn, and with [God mode], your score is not reduced.
[Safe] rule prevents score reduction if you couldn't chain a word due to single-hit words.
Speed Quiz difficulty has Easy, Normal, Hard, and you can select multiple.
[No Long] and [No Short] block 9+ letters and 8- letters respectively.
Using [Catch] in Picture Quiz presents special catch-mind style words.
If you turn on [Only Once], words used in a round cannot be used in following rounds.
In [Letter Lab] under [Edit Profile], you can combine up to 10 letters and get rewards.
In [Item Workshop] under [Edit Profile], you can combine two items to make a new one.
You can pick language in top-left settings. Korean, English, and ??? are supported.
You can pick sound pack in top-left settings. There are 6 sound packs currently.
You can change level icon and BGM freely in top-left settings.
When creating room, click [View All Rules] to see all special rules. Turn off [Simple Room View] in settings to always see them.
With [Show Rule Categories] in settings, you can group rules by category.
With [Reduce Shake] in settings, you can remove screen shake from typing long words or [Drug].
With [Auto-fill AI Settings], AI robot's previous settings are loaded when configuring it.
In Wordchain, unchainable letters are red, attack words orange, defend words blue.
When practicing or inviting KKuTu Bot, you can set its strategy (Long-word to Aggressive).
If you set KKuTu Bot's preferred letters, it tries to give them mostly.
If you turn on KKuTu Bot's chat, it talks when receiving/sending single-hit words or someone misses a turn.
If you turn on KKuTu Bot's fast mode, it ignores strategy and typing as fast as possible.
If you enable KKuTu Bot's rage-quit, it leaves if it gets too many single-hit words.
There are currently about 1.4 million Korean words in KKuTu-N.
N in KKuTu-N stands for New.
The creator of KKuTu-N also created KKuTu.site, a server list.
Copyright info used in KKuTu-N is available at the bottom [Copyright Info].
KKuTu-N was first made on Nov 25, 2025, and revealed on Dec 3, 2025.
Click the [View All Rules] button to view all available rules in the game mode.
The [Word Rain] mode is a game mode where you quickly type words falling down from the top before they touch the ground. If you successfully type a word, you can attack opponents.
The [Even] strategy evenly distributes your attacks among all opponents.
The [K.Os] strategy focuses your attacks on the opponent with the lowest HP to get a KO.
The [Payback] strategy returns the attack to the latest opponent who attacked you.
The Kkutu Bot chooses the [K.Os] strategy with the [Aggressive] personality, the [Payback] strategy with the [Long Words] personality, and the [Even] strategy with the [Balanced] personality.
[369 Game] is a game where you take turns counting from 1. If a number contains 3, 6, or 9, clap (using 짝, ㅉ, clap, or c) as many times as those digits appear, instead of saying the number.
